infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Spatial3D requires camera access to capture stereoscopic 3D photo pairs with live Cha-Cha baseline guidance and horizon leveling.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Spatial3D requires photo library access to import spatial photos/videos and save exported 3D side-by-side, anaglyph, and wigglegram media.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Spatial3D needs permission to save 3D stereoscopic photos and videos to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Spatial3D uses motion sensors (gyroscope and accelerometer) for interactive 3D parallax tilt viewing and real-time camera horizon leveling.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Spatial3D to access your camera for stereoscopic 3D capture.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Spatial3D to access your photos to import and export 3D stereo media.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow Spatial3D to save 3D stereoscopic photos and wigglegrams to your library.
